description: This file contains database migration scripts using Alembic to add and remove columns related to external management (is_managed_externally and external_url) for multiple tables in the Superset project.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Adds 'is_managed_externally' and 'external_url' columns to dashboards, datasources, dbs, slices, and tables tables.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Removes the added columns from the respective tables.
